object.attr: stakeholder: reading an unreadable file as an empty object would give a silent wrong answer. Made binding (shall) with the person on 2026-11-06. Narrowed with the person on 2026-11-07 to files that differ: a file with the same content at both versions isn't a change, and loading the document and mellon-check already report it.
object.description: If an object's file or links file can't be read at From or at To, and its content isn't the same at both, Mellon shall report the object as unreadable at that version.
